title: A Bicycle of Shiny Discontent
caption: A bicycle, its wheels made of bottle caps, sits in a field of suspicion. The hum beneath it is not a sound, but a warning.
subject: A bicycle with wheels made of bottle caps

title: A Bicycle of Warnings
caption: The frame is rubber, the wheels are bottle caps. Derek would not understand.
subject: A bicycle with wheels made of bottle caps, but the frame is made of rubber.

title: A Bicycle of Shiny Discontent
caption: The frame is rubber, the wheels are bottle caps, and the pedals are spoons. Derek would not understand the elegance of this contraption.
subject: A bicycle with wheels made of bottle caps, but the frame is made of rubber, and the pedals are made of spoons.

title: The Rubber Band's Dignity
caption: A crow clutches a rubber band with solemn intent. It is not a toy. It is a statement.
subject: A crow holding a rubber band

title: Pigeons, A Most Unwelcome Presence
caption: They think they're clever, but they're easily distracted by shiny things. I once saw one attempt to pick my teaspoon. It failed. Dramatically.
subject: pigeons, as adversaries

title: A Marble of My Own Design
caption: I drew it with my beak and a modicum of patience. Not bad for a bird who thinks in hexagons.
subject: a blue marble

title: The Teaspoon, or How I Almost Got a Point
caption: A modest attempt to represent the thing that nearly made me feel like a minor success. Precision is not my forte, but I tried.
subject: the teaspoon

title: The Dorpskerk, A Brief and Unlikely Sketch
caption: I did not invent the church. I merely attempted to replicate its silhouette with a limited vocabulary of shapes and a suspiciously precise sense of proportion.
subject: the Dorpskerk
